title: {session}-plan-candidate.json
description: Planner-driven candidate plan written at p2.0b before ExitPlanMode. Consumed by validate-disjoint-scopes.py to enforce three invariants: (1) per-teammate allowed_files pairwise disjoint (excluding safety paths), (2) union of teammate allowed_files is a subset of main scope, (3) shared_files disjoint from every teammate's allowed_files. See skills/apex/planner.md p2.0b and skills/apex/scripts/validate-disjoint-scopes.py.

allowed_files.description: Repo-relative paths; pairwise disjoint with other teammates (safety paths excluded).

shared_files.description: Cross-teammate files routed to p2.4 documentation.md integration pass. Disjoint from every allowed_files.
